description: Hydrologic Modelling of Connectivity Expert Panel Recommendations 2025–Scenario 2–End of System–Translucency is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. Set an end of system flow target (equivalent to the bottom of baseflow) in regulated valleys (Gwydir, Namoi and Border Rivers) to protect baseflows to enable baseflow targets in the Barwon-Darling to be achieved in non-dry times. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. Its tags are Analytics, Connectivity, DCCEEW - Water, DCCEEW - Water Analytics, Modelling. It offers 4 resource(s) in pdf, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-02-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
